conditionalCostModel.scope: Derived from single historical observations, no agent/tests; not an experiment speed measurement.

audit104.scope: Fresh-process cached-Base requests, two development cases; no rebuild or new correctness qualification.
audit104.note: Fresh 16 requests / two cases; all C and diagnostics match. Tiny timing differences do not establish generation acceleration. Historical B1/B2 self clocks retained; B3 executable unbuilt, B4/B5 unexecuted. Launcher clock differs from request/process clocks.

clock.label: Compiler process wall time
clock.note: The same high-resolution child wrapper measures all roles. Native and upstream internal request_ms clocks have different boundaries and are not compared. These are measured execution workflows, not identical internal compiler phases.

baseline.label: Upstream TypeScript compiler on Bun 1.4.3
baseline.basePolicy: Checks source Base in both prepared and live experiments; each experiment has independently measured upstream controls.

candidate.scope: Same-source native stage pair. B1 was built through upstream C and Clang; B2 through B1 C and the same Clang recipe. This measures the existing candidate04 compiler core, not the distinct Phase103 public CLI entry.

upstreamCompilation.ratioDefinition: Native compiler process median / independently measured upstream compiler process median; below 1 is faster.
upstreamCompilation.aggregation: For each original source, geometrically average its point ratios; geometrically average the 23 source ratios for the headline. Keep the 45-point equal-weight mean separately. Each point ratio uses two fresh-process medians per compiler and mode.
upstreamCompilation.scope: 45 closed input points from 23 original programs, measured in prepared and live Base modes. All 45 points count for compilation, including the zero-work executable control. No universal or held-out claim; do not splice these process clocks into earlier internal request-time series.

modeDefinitions.prepared: Native reuses an authenticated 1,100,924-byte prepared Base carrier; upstream reads and checks source Base. Offline carrier creation is an excluded setup cost, not zero.
modeDefinitions.live: Native and upstream read source Base and prepare it during each fresh compiler process. Native internal Base preparation excludes file reading, but the common process clock includes it.

environment.execution: Serial fresh compiler processes under the existing resource guard; no concurrent benchmark jobs or cache flushing.
environment.cachePolicy: Normal OS file caches; fresh processes do not imply cold filesystem caches or persistent warmed Bun sessions.
environment.order: Randomized/rotated role order, not perfectly counterbalanced over two/four rounds.

evidenceStatus.passed: Every timed native request matches its frozen complete C and diagnostic oracle. Every timed upstream broad output matches a separately acquired reference; all twelve selected native/upstream generated-product executions match expected complete stdout and stderr.
evidenceStatus.limits: Broad has two samples per point/role/mode; the six-source screen has four. Small differences are not statistically resolved. Product executions are correctness checks, not a new runtime benchmark. No compiler, runtime, native selection or installed release changed.

prepared.scope: Separate full 1.79 MB compiler source workload; excluded from ordinary-program averages. Prepared has two fresh-process samples per role; live has one control per role. No Clang time or public CLI launcher/authentication overhead.

live.scope: Separate full 1.79 MB compiler source workload; excluded from ordinary-program averages. Prepared has two fresh-process samples per role; live has one control per role. No Clang time or public CLI launcher/authentication overhead.
